A resilient HTTP retry transport has been implemented in [`src/retry_transport.py`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py) alongside a mock unit test suite in [`src/test_retry_transport.py`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/test_retry_transport.py), complete with ICM pipeline contracts in [`tasks/TSK-013/`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tasks/TSK-013/).

---

### Implementation Overview

1. **Exponential Backoff & Full Jitter ([`src/retry_transport.py`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py))**:
   - Implemented [`JitterStrategy`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py#L32) (`NONE`, `FULL`, `EQUAL`, `DECORRELATED`).
   - Formula for **Full Jitter**: $\text{delay} \sim \mathcal{U}(0, \min(\text{max\_delay}, \text{base\_delay} \times \text{backoff\_factor}^{\text{attempt}}))$.
   - Support for parsing HTTP `Retry-After` header values (in integer seconds or RFC 2822 / IMF-fixdate format) via [`parse_retry_after`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py#L162).

2. **Configurable Status Code & Exception Filters**:
   - [`RetryConfig`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py#L52): Configurable `retry_status_codes` (default: `{429, 500, 502, 503, 504}`), `retry_exceptions` (default: `URLError`, `TimeoutError`, `ConnectionError`, `RemoteDisconnected`, `IncompleteRead`), `max_retries`, and `raise_on_status`.
   - Non-retryable status codes (e.g., 400, 401, 404) or non-retryable exceptions exit immediately without retry delays.

3. **Pluggable Transport Abstraction & Telemetry**:
   - [`RetryTransport.execute()`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py#L254): Generic retry loop wrapping any zero-argument HTTP callable with [`RetryTelemetry`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py#L125) recording.
   - [`RetryTransport.send()`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py#L351): Standard library `urllib.request` integration.
   - Support for `on_retry` observer callbacks and injectable virtual `sleeper` functions for instantaneous, mock-driven testing.

4. **100% Mock Unit Tests ([`src/test_retry_transport.py`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/test_retry_transport.py))**:
   - Deterministic backoff calculations and clamping up to `max_delay`.
   - Statistical boundary checks for full, equal, and decorrelated jitter.
   - `Retry-After` header parsing (seconds and HTTP dates).
   - Transient failure recovery (e.g. 503 $\to$ 503 $\to$ 200).
   - Retry exhaustion behavior (response return vs. [`MaxRetriesExceededError`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/src/retry_transport.py#L147)).
   - Transient network exceptions vs. instant non-retryable exception failure.
   - Custom status code filtering and `urllib` mock response handling.
